name: @miragon/design-iq-validator
description: Platform-owned validator for designIQ content repos — designiq.yml discovery, BPMN/DMN structure and diagram coverage, cross-model references, the schema check of Team Topologies, Context Maps and Value Chains, and a parse check for every other notation. Runs against any checkout via --root; never executes content-repo code.
//: fast-xml-parser stays a RUNTIME dependency although src/ no longer imports it directly: tsdown inlines @designiq/notations (whose extract.ts imports it) but keeps npm deps external, so the published dist/ resolves it from here. Removing it breaks the npm artifact at import time while the workspace keeps working. @miragon/wardley-dsl and @miragon/wardley-schema-model are ones for the same reason (extract.ts reads a Wardley Map with the one and its stages with the other). zod is a RUNTIME dependency too: src/ never imports it, but the wardley-dsl and the team-topologies, context-maps and value-chain schema models take it as a peer, and the published package is what provides it.
